text: Shady Quickshank is a gnome reagent & poison vendor located at Darkbreak Cove in the Alliance cavern in the Abyssal Depths.
The Shadowstalker Scalp dropped from Hatefury Shadowstalkers at Sargeron in Desolace.
Shaggy Black Bears are black bears found in the southwestern area of Western Plaguelands.
__NOTOC__ Shadril is a venom spider in the gold mine north of Hearthglen in the Western Plaguelands. It is terrorizing the Hearthglen Drudges within the cave.

Shadybranch Pocket is a small wooded area nestled between the Serpent's Heart and the Temple of the Jade Serpent in the Jade Forest. The Orchid Hollow is just to the south. Foxes and orchids reside here. A pandaren dig site is located under the Great Bridge connecting the Jade Temple Grounds to the Serpent's Heart.
Shadowmourne - Guild Edition is a guild achievement for having a member with Shadowmourne.

Shai Cliffwatcher is a pandaren found overlooking Krasarang Wilds at the Winds' Edge south of the Imperial Granary on the southern border of the Valley of the Four Winds. He is situated next to a warning sign, bag of airy hops, and a rappelling rope to get to the bottom of the cliff. Players pass Shai on The Quest for Better Barley.

Shaghorns are goats located in Verdant Belt, the areas surrounding Halfhill and the Heartland in the Valley of the Four Winds. Some are led by Halfhill Goatherds and Stoneplow Goatherds. Occasionally, dead ones can be found, being eaten by longfang wolves. They don't have nearly enough fat on them.
Shadowy Recall is the Mastery for Shadow Priests. It gives Shadow Word: Pain, Devouring Plague, Vampiric Touch, Mind Sear and Mind Flay a chance to deal damage twice, each time they deal damage.

Shadraspawn Venomspitters are venom spiders found in the Creeping Ruin of the Hinterlands. They have grown large enough to drag off an entire dwarf in the night, proven by their Cocooned Victims all through the ruins. They feed off their victims' bodies for days keeping them fat and thriving, and thus Gilda Cloudcaller wants to remove their food resources by killing the victims. As their name says, they are the spawn of the loa Shadra.
Shady Nook Guardians are brown bears found around the Shady Nook in Ashenvale.
The Shadowswift Brotherhood is a structure located in the Cleft of Shadow of Orgrimmar. Rogue trainers can be found here.
Shadowy Constructs are bone golems found in the Halls of Anguish in the Black Temple.
Shaggy Desert Coyotes are coyotes found in the Cradle of the Ancients in Uldum.
Shahandana is a shivarra that stands on a hill northeast of the Dark Portal in the Blasted Lands. She is speaking to a crowd of Enthralled Cultists.
Shaggy is rewarded to players when they become best friends with Farmer Fung. He stays in the pen at Sunsong Ranch.

Shadows of the Loa is a lore object found at inside one of the Harbingers of the Loa tents in central Za'Tual on the southern side of the Isle of Thunder. Interacting with the lore object is one of the requirements of the Pandaria exploration achievement The Zandalari Prophecy.
Shadowskulk Leggings are a random world drop from Cataclysm mobs.
Shagra was a worgen who, alongside Gorfang, attacked Revil Kost, Karlain and Ambrose at the entrance of Roland's Doom. Ambrose killed the two worgen very quickly. Shagra spoke in broken Common.
Shaggy Longhorn is a yak located at the Fire Camp Bataar in Kun-Lai Summit.
The Shadowveil Robe is a quest reward from Sethe, the Dead God.
__NOTOC__ Shadowspeaker Niir is a draenei located on at Socrethar's Rise in .
The Shadowthrash Cloak is created from a Baleful Cloak when used by a: * Priest * Mage
Shadowveil Gloves is a quest reward from Declawing The Bloodmane.
Shagor's Collar drops from Shagor in Lok-rath in . After the quest, the collar can be found at Yrel's Watch or Riverside Post.
Shadowy Inspiration is a level 15 Demonology warlock talent.
__NOTOC__ Shadowrubies can be found when Prospecting Felslate and Leystone Ore.
Shadowy Coins was a currency that was scrapped during the beta test of Legion.
Shadowy Minions are seen during Gara'jal's encounter in Mogu'shan Vaults.

Shaksa is the eldest daughter and oldest child of Nokrar and Kagra and would follow her parents, along with her siblings, when they left the clan to join the Horde. However en route they would be attacked and the children would become separated from their parents, but thanks to the timely arrival of the draenei the children would be safely escorted back to the Frostwolves. They later be reunited with their mother when Durotan returned with her, though the children would learn that their father was dead killed by the Redwalkers. After traveling through the to Azeroth, Shaksa and her siblings were eventually killed by the other orcs of the Horde, following the Frostwolves' meeting with the hum
Shadowsworn Harbingers are eredar that appear during the battle for Broken Shore and during the assault on Broken Shore. They also appeared at Legion Invasion locations.
Shadowy Illusions are summoned by Malphazel during the Legion Invasion.
Shadowstone is looted from Horde Supplies in Hillsbrad Foothills during Stage 3 of the Legion Invasion.

.]] Shal'Aran is an underground ruin in Meredil in Suramar. Withered avoid it, which makes it a good refuge for First Arcanist Thalyssra and a class leader when fleeing from a swarm of Withered crawling around Meredil. It is initially occupied by the banshee Keeper Selentia; after clearing Shal'Aran on Arcane Thirst, it becomes the staging ground for the fledging nightfallen rebellion against Grand Magistrix Elisande, led by Thalyssra. Occupied by the resistance, Shal'Aran slowly comes to life, gradually filling with resistance sympathizers and refugees from all over Suramar, who also clear the debris and fill the chamber with their belongings, supplies, and decorations. Notably, Valewalker
Shae is a storm drake located in Shield's Rest in Stormheim during Shrine of the Truthguard (quest).

Shaku, the Collector is a mysterious being active in Gadgetzan in the Mean Streets of Gadgetzan expansion for Hearthstone. He is a sha, but he has gained a much higher level of sentience than the rest of his kin. He is "super evil, super old, and super greedy", and is rumored to whisper the name "Shaohao".
Shadowy Figure is a tauren located at in the Wailing Caverns. He seems to be responsible for what is going on in the Wailing Caverns.
Shadowquill is an owl located in the eastern part of the Feathermane Hunting Grounds bordering Val'sharah in Suramar.
Shadowy Incantations is an Affliction warlock artifact trait. It is linked to the Soul Flame (artifact trait) and Hideous Corruption traits.
Shadows of the Flesh is an Affliction warlock artifact trait. It is linked to the Inimitable Agony, Drained to a Husk and Harvester of Souls (artifact trait) traits.
__NOTOC__ Shadowsworn Betrayers are eredar located in Invasion Points.
Shadowseeker Panthara are panthara located at the Isolon Basin in Eredath.
__NOTOC__ Shadowy Executioners are humans and jungle trolls located in Grangol'var Village in Terokkar Forest.
__NOTOC__ The Shadowy Pile of Bones can drop from Nefarian in Blackwing Descent.
Shadowstalker Ezrekius was a Nightmare-corrupted satyr located in Val'sharah. He was taken out by the champions of the class orders.
__NOTOC__ Shal'dorei Civilians are nightborne located in Suramar.
__NOTOC__ Shadowsworn Netherguards are orcs located in Felwood. They are connected to Phaseleashed Imps.
__NOTOC__ Shadowsworn Occultists are undead and humans located in the Blasted Lands.
__NOTOC__ Shadowsworn Spellblades are orcs and jungle trolls located in Blasted Lands.
Shadowsworn Obstructors are voidwalkers located in Blasted Lands.

Shakor is the ice troll chieftain of the Winterfang tribe. He discovered that his cousin Kril plotted against Malakk and the Drakkari. Shakor discovered this, but decided not to kill him as they were family. Instead, he demanded an apology.
Shal'dorei Archmages are nightborne located in Suramar and in Nighthold.
Shal'dorei Naturalists are nightborne located in Suramar and in Nighthold.
Shady Individuals are humans located in settlements throughout in Tiragarde Sound.

Shadowprey Orcas are orcas found in the waters near Shadowprey Village in Desolace. They can be seen from the shore.
Shadows of the Uncrowned is a Subtelty rogue artifact trait. It is linked to the Weak Point traits. It Appears after completing A Gift From the Six.
Shadowspawns are psyfiend located in Deliverance Point on the Broken Shore, seen only by priest players.
Shadra Silk Sash is a quest reward from world quests on Zandalar.
Shadra Silk Footwraps are a quest reward from world quests on Zandalar.
Shadric Crawlers are spider located in Dazar'alor and in the areas of Zuldazar.

Shakaeja is a Zandalari troll located inside the Temple of Akunda in Vol'dun. She is initially known as Akunda the Revered and is one of the trolls responsible for keeping Akunda incapacitated, but she resumes her true name and kneels down next to the freed loa after completion of Ending the Madness.
Shaky Ragnan is a skeletal troll located underwater between the central and southern docks in the Port of Zem'lan in Vol'dun.

Shady Deckhands are members of the Ashvane Trading Company located across Redrock Harbor and aboard The Siren's Call in Vol'dun. Some are sneaking around in Stealth and inspecting the supplies around the area, while others are out in the open conversing with one another. There are reports that they've been stealing supplies from the company, and Dockmaster Herrington asks adventurers (disguised with Ashvane Garb) to confront them.
__NOTOC__ Shadowy Summoners are members of the Shadow Council located at Grangol'var Village in Terokkar Forest.
Shadowsouls are voidwraiths summoned by Kil'jaeden in the Twisting Nether in the Tomb of Sargeras.

The Shadra'Zan is or was a tight society of Zandalari alchemists. Entrance into the guild included a ritual which required the inductee to imbibe a potion made from their own blood. Should they withstand the effects, they were deemed worthy to learn the secrets kept within.
The Shadowveil Mantle is a quest reward from Hidden in Plain Sight.
The Shadowveil Wristwraps is a quest reward from The Bloodmane.

Shagtusk is a quilboar who tried to use the dryad Taryndrella to purify the cursed place of Razorfen Downs. Both were captured by Chugara Razorflank and Death Speaker Blackthorn. Aramar Thorne and his group of friends then entered the Downs and with the help of Shagtusk located Chugara and Blackthorn in the Bone Pile. Blackthorn tried to raise Amnennar the Coldbringer and sacrifice Drella to the lich, but the effort was ultimately thwarted by Reigol Valdread.
Shadra Disciple's Hexknife is rewarded from Mistress of Lies.
Shadra Disciple's Stabber is a quest reward from Mistress of Lies.
The Shadowveil Hood is a quest reward from A Feast of Shadows
__NOTOC__ Shadowspeaker Angolo is an ice troll located on the expedition isles.
__NOTOC__ The Shadowscrawled Tome is a book with rare quality that can be acquired from Mysterious Satchel (Brawler's Guild), at the end of Brawler's Guild storyline.
Shadowspike Lurker is a spider crab located just outside the Chitterspine Grotto in Nazjatar.
Shal'dorei Arcanists are two nightborne located in Pathfinder's Den in Orgrimmar maintaining a portal.
__NOTOC__ Shady Thugs are goblins located in Crapopolis. After speaking, some of them turn .
Shadowy Disguise is a toy earned from the Pet Battle Challenge: Blackrock Depths achievement.
Shadra Silk Headband is a quest reward from world quests on Zandalar.
Shadra Silk Robes are a quest reward from world quests on Zandalar.
Shadra Silk Mantle is a quest reward from world quests on Zandalar.
Shadra Silk Cuffs are a quest reward from world quests on Zandalar.
Shadra Silk Gloves are a quest reward from world quests on Zandalar.
Shadra Silk Legwraps is a quest reward from world quests on Zandalar.

Shadows Rising is a novel written by Madeleine Roux taking place after the events of Battle for Azeroth, serving as a tie-in to Shadowlands. It focuses on characters from the Alliance, Horde, and Sylvanas Windrunner, with a primary focus on the Horde.
__NOTOC__ Shadowsworn Acolytes are k'thir located in the Vale of Eternal Twilight.
__NOTOC__ Shadowsworn Disciples are k'thir located in the Vale of Eternal Twilight.
Shadra-Spawn Venom Samples drop from the Spawn of Shadra in the Hinterlands.

Shadowstalker Arachnar is a fal'dorei located in the Shadowlands. It was encountered by the champions of the Knights of the Ebon Blade when they came for Salanar the Horseman during the third invasion of the Burning Legion.
__NOTOC__ Shadowy Shanks drop from all manner of beasts in the Shadowlands, can be looted from meat satchels, and is used as a currency for Ta'tru's wares.
Shadraspawn Lurkers are spiders located in Skyrender Eyrie in Zuldazar.
Shadowrider Neralva is a venthyr stable master located in Darkhaven in Revendreth.
The Shadowy Figures are a group of battle pet tamers. Their leader, Tasha Riley, describes them as a band of misfits.

Shake the Foundations is a conduit for elemental shaman. It drops from Echelon in the Halls of Atonement and Sylvanas Windrunner in the Sanctum of Domination.
The Shadowy Key would have been obtained in Mort'regar in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Shadowy Tomes are tomes located in the Ruined Passage in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.
Shadowy Appendages are eye stalks located in the Crucible of Storms.

Shaking Pet Carrier is the 2020 Winter Veil gift, found in the appropriately-named Winter Veil Gift from December 25 to January 2 in Ironforge and Orgrimmar. Players acquire Jingles, the baby purple raptor.
Shadowspeaker's Shard drops from Shadowspeaker Niir at Socrethar's Rise in .

]] The Shadowsteel Foundry is the first section of the Sanctum of Domination that players enter after defeating the Tarragrue and entering the Sanctum proper. Here, Mawsworn toil away on inanimate soulseekers, Mawsworn armor suits, and a lone Shadowsteel Colossus. The foundry is entered from the southeast via a portal from lower Torghast. In the southwest it leads out onto the Eye's Overlook.
Shadraspawn Waistguard is a quest reward from Can't Make An Omelette Without... (Horde).
Shadowmourne Monster Offhand was never available to players.
Shadowshroud Vambraces drop from Yazma in Atal'Dazar. They are also looted from Challenger's Cache.
Shaggy Rabbits are rabbits found in various locations on the Dragon Isles.
Shaggy Dreamhares are rabbits found near Groundskeeper Kama in the Emerald Enclave in Valdrakken.
Shakey Flatlap is a goblin located at the Artisan's Market in Valdrakken.
Shadowy Blademaster's Greatsword is available for purchase from the Trading Post during March for 225 Trader's Tender.
Shadowy Mojo Crystals are created with the Swirling Mojo Stone.

Shafina is a dryad found in the Eye of Ysera in the Emerald Dream.

Shadowsong is a family of night elves. The Shadowsong family was not of noble blood, and so Maiev and Jarod had earned their positions through skill and hard work.
A shaman set refers to a collection of equipment with a shaman class restriction that provides an additional bonus when worn together.

.]] Shan'do is a courtesy title of great respect meaning "honored teacher" in Darnassian, the language of the night elves. It can also be translated as "honored instructor". The complementary honorific is thero'shan ("honored student"). The nightborne also use the title of "honored teacher", though the Shalassian word for it is unknown. __NOTOC__
Shalumon is a night elf tabard vendor located in the Craftsmen's Terrace in Darnassus. During the Burning of Teldrassil, he was caught in the chaos and could be saved.
__NOTOC__ Shanda is a night elf priest trainer located in Aldrassil in Teldrassil. It is unknown whether she survived the Burning of Teldrassil.
The Shard of the Flame drops from Ragnaros in the Molten Core.

Shaol'watha is a Vilebranch forest troll ruin in northeastern Hinterlands. The Revantusk tribe and the Wildhammer Clan are fighting for the territory. It seems the Wildhammer dwarves are gaining the upper hand, as they have taken over many of the former troll camps nearby.

__NOTOC__ Shaldyn was a night elf cloth armor vendor located in Auberdine in Darkshore. After the Cataclysm, she tried to escape Auberdine's destruction but was severely injured on the beach at Mist's Edge. She was taken to Lor'danel by the Sentinels during The Last Wave of Survivors, but she ultimately died; her name is now listed on the Auberdine Memorial placed in Lor'danel.
The Shard of the Scale dropped from Onyxia in Onyxia's Lair.
__NOTOC__ Shanda the Spinner is a rare tarantula, found in a cave in Loch Modan. She is on a 4-6 hour respawn timer.
__NOTOC__ Shara Sunwing is a blood elf general goods vendor located at the Sunspire on Sunstrider Isle in Eversong Woods.
__NOTOC__ Shalannius is a night elf druid trainer located at Valaar's Berth in Azuremyst Isle.
__NOTOC__ Shamblehide Chestguard is a rare quality chest that drops off The Black Stalker in the Underbog in Coilfang Reservoir.
The Shard of the Green Flame is an off-hand item available exclusively to warlocks by finishing the quest Kroshius' Infernal Core (quest).
Shard of Azzinoth is an epic dagger that drops from Illidan Stormrage in the Black Temple.
Shango is a Loa of Storm. Shadow Hunter Kajassa uses Shadowy Blessing of Shango which bestows a turbulent stealth that cannot be seen or heard by enemies.
__NOTOC__ Shaleskin Flayers are rock flayers found in the western Netherstorm.
Shaleskin Cape is a quest reward from A Taste of Flame (3) which begins with Cyrus Therepentous in Slither Rock in the Burning Steppes.

The Shard of Water is provided as an objective for Call of Water (9).
The Shard of Contempt is dropped by Priestess Delrissa in Heroic Magisters' Terrace.

The Shalassi Oracle's Sandals were a quest reward from Rescue Deirom! and Rescue Dugar!. They're likely named after the Shalassi or Veil Shalas.
The Shalassi Sentry's Epaulets were a quest reward from Rescue Deirom! and Rescue Dugar!. They're likely named after the Shalassi or Veil Shalas.
Shandra is a gnome arcanist who fought many clockwerk goblins in order to reach the enemy goblin tinker.

The Shaper's Terrace is a titan-related area found in Un'Goro Crater on the bluffs above Marshal's Refuge to the east, as well as a similar structure that was revealed on the eastern wall of Un'Goro, when the cloaking device failed during the Cataclysm.

Shanger was a goblin inventor who developed a tech-mod, called "Shanger's Scalder" entirely on accident. The mod added a series of superheated coils wrapped around an internal compartment filled with water. When the heating mechanism is activated, the water quickly boils over, producing gouts of steam that hiss from small jets all along the weapon's surface. It was usually filled with water, but virtually any liquid could be used, except flammable stuff. Rumor has it that he was trying to employ lamp oil in a modified warhammer when he met his unfortunate end. A dwarf engineer happened to find the "broken" weapon in a trash heap and refined the idea for his own use.
Shalassi Oracles are arakkoa found at Veil Shalas in Terokkar Forest.
Shalassi Sentries could be found in Veil Shalas, Terokkar Forest.
Shalassi Talonguards are arakkoa found at Veil Shalas in Terokkar Forest.
Shaman Jakjek is an elite wolvar quest giver found at Kartak's Hold in Sholazar Basin. He is only visible to those allied with the Frenzyheart.
Shard of the Earth is provided as an objective for Rallying the Troops.
Shaman Partak is a level 78 elite wolvar poison and reagent vendor located at Frenzyheart Hill in the Sholazar Basin.

Shambles is a wight food and drink vendor who is affiliated with the Knights of the Ebon Blade. He appears at the Shadow Vault after the player completes the quest The Duke. Interestingly enough this NPC seems to no make a sound effect when clicked upon but has been reported to make an undead groan noise every time a player sells an item to him.

Shambling mounds are creatures found both in the Emerald Dream and on Azeroth. In theory they could be affected by the plague. Shambling Mounds are fully described in Manual of Monsters Appendix Three, however the validity of the source is disputed.
Shaleskin Ripper were rock flayers found around Manaforge Ultris in Netherstorm, before the Consortium quests were added in patch 2.1.0.
Shard of Flame is a passive buff that triggers from the trinkets Reign of the Dead (Alliance) and Reign of the Unliving (Horde).
Shalewing is Overlord Drakuru's gargoyle pet found in Voltarus in Zul'Drak. He carries off the Drakkari Chieftains in the quest Fuel for the Fire (quest).

Shandy Glossgleam is a gnome found on the upstairs balcony of Photonic Playground (or Threads of Fate) in Dalaran. He washes people's clothes using his personal water elemental, Aquanos. His laundry service is instrumental in A Suitable Disguise.
Shard of Pirouetting Happiness is equivalent to Shard of the Crystal Forest, which is available from vendors in Dalaran.
Shara Blazen is a Forsaken located inside the old church in Tarren Mill in Hillsbrad Foothills. She was present during the Legion Invasions, throwing torches.
The Shapeless are a vaguely humanoid species that were described as the "Play-Doh of the Old Gods".
Shambling Horrors are vargul that spawns during the Lich King encounter in Icecrown Citadel.

Shammoz is a Community MVP on the EU forums. He mainly posts in Customer & Technical Support, as well as General Discussion. Shammoz posts as a level 100 female draenei shaman from Ghostlands (EU). A welcome post was made on June 4, 2010 by Wryxian.
A Customer Service MVP on the official forums since May 2010. His forum avatar is a level 85 female night elf priest from Runetotem US.
Shalewind Belt is a quest reward from The Grand Magus Doane.

Shallow's End is a small area overlooking the Lightless Reaches in Kelp'thar Forest. It's here that Erunak Stonespeaker, Rendel Firetongue, and Moanah Stormhoof of the Earthen Ring save the adventurer from being dragged away by a naga. While Erunak Stonespeaker tries to come up with a place to for shelter from the naga, Morah Stormhoof tries to get the adventurer more reliable transportation under the waters.
Shalla Whiteleaf is a tauren druid trainer located in the Valley of Spirits in Orgrimmar. After Vol'jin's death, she was speaking with Nohi Plainswalker.
Shard of Petrified Wood is a common fossil archaeology artifact that requires 30 Fossil Archaeology Fragments to complete. It can be discovered at any skill level.
__NOTOC__ Shalug'doom, the Axe of Unmaking drops from Cho'gall in the Bastion of Twilight.
Shard-Keeper Helm is a quest reward from A Little on the Side.

Shannon Lamb is a level 52 stable master located near the inn in the Sludge Fields of Hillsbrad Foothills. Her pet jaguar's name is Beauxbeaux. She was present during the Legion Invasions. She is likely the wife of .
Shale Drilldeep is an earthen reagents and poison vendor found in Deepholm.
Sharax the Defiler is a satyr found in Darkshore. He managed to corrupt the Blackwood furbolgs and to set up Jadefire Braziers.

Shang Xi's Academy is the in-game faction of starting playable pandaren, who start their adventure on the Wandering Isle of Shen-zin Su. For nearly three generations, the esteemed Shang Xi has prepared pandaren heroes for lives of adventure.

The Shang Xi Training Grounds is the initial spawning location for newly-created pandaren. Located on the northeast portion of Shen-zin Su, the Wandering Isle, adventurers learn under the tutelage of Master Shang Xi. The place is a monastery and has its own small temple. Every adventurer that leaves these training grounds must be ready to take up arms in defense of their fellow pandaren.

Shang's Valley is a small valley with a small shrine at its center in the Jade Forest. It can be found just south of the Temple of the Jade Serpent. The Tasters' Arena is on the ridge comprising the southern side of the valley. Occasionally the monk Urobi the Walker can be found at this shrine mediating.

Shang's Stead is a small farmhouse, owned by Shang Thunderfoot, found in the western Thunderfoot Fields of eastern Valley of the Four Winds. Shang's apprentice, Francis the Shepherd Boy, watches over his nearby sheep farm.
Shang Thunderfoot is a pandaren at Shang's Stead in the Valley of the Four Winds.

Shallowstep Pass is a lightly-guarded pass between the Gao-Ran Battlefront and the great wall serving as the border of Kun-Lai Summit. Krik'thik Scentlayers are stealthing their way through the pass, reaching the Dampsoil Burrow to the northeast. Just to the north is Hatred's Vice, and the pass's southern end is marked by the Horrid March of the Dread Wastes.
Shao the Defiant is a pandaren located at Nectarbreeze Orchard in Jade Forest.
Shan'ze Spirit Apparitions are mogu ghosts located at the Terrace of Ten Thunders in the Jade Forest. They are summoned by Shan'ze Spiritbinders.

Shan Jitong is the leader of the mogu spiritclaws at the Terrace of Ten Thunders who attempt to summon spirits to embody the ancient mogu statues of the site. Their rituals were stopped by the spirit of Pei-Zhi and adventurers. When Pei-Zhi opened The Tan-Chao, Shan Jitong opened a portal to his location, captured him again, and shackled him to a Stonebound Colossus in the Seat of the Spirit Waker. The adventurer defeated the colossus, and Pei-Zhi dispelled Shan Jitong's shield, allowing the adventurer to kill him.

Shan'ze Spiritclaws are mogu found at the Terrace of Ten Thunders in the Jade Forest. During To Bridge Earth and Sky, they attack Pei-Zhi but are killed once his spell with The Tan-Chao is completed, the mogu are killed in an explosion.
Shan'ze Serpentbinders are mogu located at Shan'ze Dao in the Townlong Steppes. They are seen corrupting Wild Cloudrunners into Shan'ze Cloudrunners.
Shan'ze Cloudrunners are Wild Cloudrunners corrupted by Shan'ze Serpentbinders.
Shan'ze Illusionists are elite mogu at Shan'ze Dao in Townlong Steppes.
Shan'ze Beastmasters are mogu beastmasters of the Shan'ze clan, found in Shan'ze Dao. They each lead a pack of 5 Bronze Quilen and can summon Quilen Stonemaws.

concept art of four (or five) pandaren clans.]] at BlizzCon 2011.]] Shao'din is the word for a pandaren clan in Pandaren. Concept art exists for clans in Mists of Pandaria, but they never appeared in the expansion itself, being replaced by monk and priest orders serving the four August Celestials. The original concepted clans were as such: *Jade Serpent clan, later evolving into the Order of the Cloud Serpent *Black Ox clan, later evolving into the Niuzao sentinels *Red Crane clan, later evolving into the Crane Wing order *White Tiger clan, later evolving into the White Tiger order *Shado-Pan clan, eventually losing its clanic status
A Shao-Tien Spirit Dagger is provided by for the Golden Lotus daily quest Free Spirits.
Shao-Tien Cage Keys are held by Shao-Tien Torturers and potentially other mogu at the Ruins of Guo-Lai in northwest Vale of Eternal Blossoms.
Shan'ze Infiltrators are mogu located at the Underbough in the Townlong Steppes.
Shan'ze Invaders are mogu found storming the bridge between the Shado-Pan Garrison and Niuzao Temple in the Townlong Steppes with air support from Shan'ze Cloudriders.
Shan'ze Cloudriders are cloud serpents located at the Shado-Pan Garrison in the Townlong Steppes. They act as air support for Shan'ze Invaders.
There are two types of Shan'ze Brutalizers. One set is at Niuzao Temple during the Shado-Pan capstone quest Surprise Attack! The other set is guarding the Thunder Forges on the Isle of Thunder.
